status: Retrospective grid frozen before these new fits. Existing results and earlier grids already known; not preregistration.
calendar: reviewed_G documented phases. Pre years g-L,...,g-1; post years g+lag,...,g+lag+L-1. Omit g as transition for lag=1.
company_selection: Largest positive-cap security per vendor company at g-1, fixed line/country/company through all window years; complete all three outcomes; >=30 companies per country-stack.
never_treated: No unsupported never-treated coding. Documented later adoption G>end is required for controls; >=3 comparison countries per cohort.
censor: USA beneficial ownership and Germany supply-chain if window ends >=2025.
controls_timing: Prior-calendar-year log real GDP per capita, GDP growth and trade/GDP. Complete all window years; no filling missing controls.
index: Equal mean of three proxies standardized using complete, deduplicated 2000 companies, with direction higher=less liquid; no optimized outcome weights.
stack_weight: Constant within country-stack. Within-stack country weights normalized to unit total; cohorts weighted by adopting-country baseline mass. Normalize family total mass to requested equal/cap family mass. Direct stack slope additionally reflects residualized treatment information.
inference: Country-cluster sandwich, shared-country covariance retained across families/stacks, t with G-1 df; HC1 includes absorbed stack-country and stack-year df. Conditional on sample, phase calendar and GLS estimated weights.
gls: Inverse cross-family country-score covariance only if full rank and condition<1e8. Positive variant minimizes same variance subject to nonnegative weights sum=1. Estimated weights conditional; not population policy averages.
diagnostics: Every family/cohort support or failure retained
Event-study pre-lead Wald test on identical sample
multiplicity: Holm across all 5184 attempted focal cells, including failures assigned p=1; BH also descriptive. Within-public following-year spread priority set includes all winsor/window/within/controls/pooling choices, not chosen by sign.
stopping: Complete declared grid and diagnostics regardless of significance; report candidates with qualifications and full matrix. Do not continue until a favourable p-value is found.
limitations: National phase exposure rather than verified issuer eligibility
Simultaneous other reforms not ruled out
Country clustering does not prove independence across supranational legal waves
GLS common-effect restriction may fail across heterogeneous families
